source.selectedAgentId: agent plan adapted into the single-glider H1 runtime path
source.challengeId: challenge or instance id from the packet
source.replaySeedAnchor: seed/replay identity carried from the packet

visibilityValidation.hiddenTruthIncluded: true only for explicit oracle/debug packet workflows
visibilityValidation.visibleFieldIds: field keys detected in solver-visible planning data

planValidation.routeIssueCount: shared browser route validation issue count when available

runtime.usesSyntheticRuntimeFieldsForExecution: H3/H3.1 bridge uses existing H1 educational runtime fields

notes: H3.1 reports document compatibility from solver packet to submitted plan to Node headless bundle. Consumers should write the canonical type anchor.headless.solver-roundtrip-report and may accept legacy anchor.headless.roundtrip-report. The report does not make headless scoring official browser scoring and does not add a planner, Python simulator, calibrated forecast, backend, or MARL/RL.
